verdict.rationale: Raygun exposes APIs, such as the Deployments API and source map upload API, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows versioned API endpoints or a documented deprecation policy. The hasher version setting is an error-grouping feature, not API versioning, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
